about: The selectors that only later headers of the plugin SDK declare and the application has no method for, by class, each with the type encoding the Objective-C compiler gives the declaration of those headers. kept: the properties a plugin can set, [name, - or + for a class property, getter, its types, setter, its types], which the application keeps with the object and reads back. neutral: the selectors of features the application does not have, which answer nil, zero or nothing. answered: the selectors of the viewer and of its view that the application has something behind, which LaterPluginSDKViewerAnswers adds with these types. LaterPluginSDKAnswers adds each to its class when the application starts; tools/plugin-sdk-selector-sweep.py table writes this file.
